_comment: Artifacts (FULL-GAME 8.3; cooks/endgame.md 2.6; cooks/build-portals-artifacts.md 2.12-2.14). Read by WRArtifacts.cpp. A charm on one of three belt hooks; Weight I-V by its metal; Artifact Level (AL) = the sum of the hooked Weights, capped by the server's artifactCap. perAL: what each AL adds (the party's highest AL counts for the shared numbers; the rule is the wearer's alone). rule: the code hook (WRArtifacts::Has); numbers per rule in its row. source: the boss or land whose drops carry it (boss = a creature id; portal:<biome>; raid:<pair>). All first drafts.

artifacts.name: Wyrm's Stillness
artifacts.geis: You may not roll. Backstep and jump still work.
artifacts.look: A curled ice-white wyrm scale on a thong

artifacts.name: Hive Seed
artifacts.geis: What you kill bursts: a breath's swell, then spores on you within 3 m.
artifacts.look: A dried spore pod in a wire cage

artifacts.name: Forge-brand
artifacts.geis: Your path's power burns you too: every ability you use deals you 8% of its damage.
artifacts.look: A smith's nail bent into a ring

artifacts.name: Leech Tooth
artifacts.geis: Healing potions heal you by half.
artifacts.look: A three-pointed leech jaw in amber

artifacts.name: Omen of the End
artifacts.geis: A boss that turns on you fights with its next phase's moves.
artifacts.look: A pebble that floats a finger's width above its cord

artifacts.name: Mourner's Veil
artifacts.geis: Your light reaches half as far: torches, lanterns, glowing tames.
artifacts.look: A scrap of black lace with a tiny silver bell

artifacts.name: Rod-crown
artifacts.geis: Lightning finds you: outdoors in rain or storm, a bolt every 40 to 60 s.
artifacts.look: A ring of green copper wire with a fulgurite bead

artifacts.name: Gnomon Eye
artifacts.geis: You see no enemy's health. Read their bodies instead.
artifacts.look: A sunstone eye in a bronze lid

artifacts.name: Seed-heart
artifacts.geis: Potions work only standing still: drinking roots you and takes 1.5 s.
artifacts.look: A heartwood acorn

artifacts.name: Gale Feather
artifacts.geis: You're thrown twice as far, and every heavy blow knocks you down.
artifacts.look: A long white feather bound with silk

artifacts.name: Glass Guard
artifacts.geis: Blocking costs you twice the stamina.
artifacts.look: A violet crystal shard

artifacts.name: Undertow Pearl
artifacts.geis: Your stamina comes back only while you move.
artifacts.look: A black pearl

artifacts.name: Bellows Lung
artifacts.geis: Your stamina comes back at seven tenths.
artifacts.look: A tiny leather bellows

artifacts.name: Rime Ring
artifacts.geis: A blow that lands while you're winded (stamina under 30) freezes you.
artifacts.look: A ring of blue glacier ice that never melts

artifacts.name: Copper Tongue
artifacts.geis: Your parry window is 30% shorter.
artifacts.look: A copper tongue-plate from a Rodwarden bell

artifacts.name: Open Vein
artifacts.geis: Nothing heals you above 70% of your health.
artifacts.look: A bone hook with a red thread

artifacts.name: The Feather
artifacts.geis: A blow you take within 2 s of a kill hurts twice.
artifacts.look: An ostrich feather in a bronze clip

artifacts.name: Thorn Oath
artifacts.geis: You may not block. Parry still works.
artifacts.look: A twist of briar

artifacts.name: Kite String
artifacts.geis: Falls hurt from 3 m and kill from 10 m.
artifacts.look: A coil of kite line on a bone reel

artifacts.name: Wardcarver's Chime
artifacts.geis: Every spell you cast rings out: creatures within 40 m come.
artifacts.look: A small chime stone

artifacts.name: Lonely Tide
artifacts.geis: Your tames won't fight; at a boss they wait at its edge.
artifacts.look: A Saltkin shell with a hole worn through

artifacts.name: Grave Count
artifacts.geis: Die in a boss fight and you can't hurt that boss again until the fight resets.
artifacts.look: A lead coffin nail

artifacts.name: Mycelial Sight
artifacts.geis: Your own bars are gone. Your body tells you: breath, a red edge, a heartbeat.
artifacts.look: A glow-cap button

artifacts.name: Hollow Coin
artifacts.geis: Every blow you take lowers your greatest health by 1 until you rest.
artifacts.look: A coin with a hole where its face was

artifacts.name: Connla's first geis: never turn back
artifacts.geis: You may not roll or step back away from your target.
artifacts.look: A knot of red and white cord

artifacts.name: Blood-price
artifacts.geis: Every Wildbrand and spell also costs you 5 health.
artifacts.look: A drake's fang in copper wire

artifacts.name: Conaire's geis: never go sunwise
artifacts.geis: Circling your target sunwise (clockwise) costs 6 stamina a second.
artifacts.look: A sun disc with a crack across it

artifacts.name: Connla's third geis: never tell your name
artifacts.geis: No ally's heal, buff or revive reaches you; your name is hidden.
artifacts.look: A blank bone tag

artifacts.name: Connla's second geis: never refuse a challenge
artifacts.geis: Every creature that sees you comes; you can't sneak; bosses chase you twice as far.
artifacts.look: A wind-pole scrap knotted round a spore

artifacts.name: The Hag's Offer
artifacts.geis: The first time each fight you fall under half health, you drink a potion whether you want to or not.
artifacts.look: A cracked clay cup on a cord
